headline: China: Strong recovery in manufacturing – August PMI at 18-month high
summary: The RatingDog manufacturing PMI rose to 51.5 in August from 50.9, an 18-month high. Production and new orders expanded at faster rates, according to the report.
why: Purchasing managers' indexes track factory activity and are closely watched as an early read on China's economic momentum. Stronger readings can support demand for commodities and exports.
